props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in pixels. The width fills the container.

props.name: fontSize
props.description: Smallest and largest font size, in viewBox pixels.

props.name: rotation
props.description: Share of words turned 90°, from 0 to 1. Which ones is decided by the seed.

props.name: seed
props.description: Same seed, same words, same layout — so a cloud does not reshuffle on every render.

props.name: maxWords
props.description: Draw at most this many words, heaviest first.

props.name: format
props.description: Format weights in the tooltip and the list.
